Yet again a short-looking set of patch notes for SOOOOO much work!

[list]
[*]Level 3 should now be working and completable. Lots of stuff isn't finished tho - the aliens won't follow and you can't enter the UFO. This should be finished tomorrow.

Apologies for the silence over the weekend, but just occasionally I have Socialise. Should be full steam ahead until we leave Early Access now!

notes.title: Patch 0.0008
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Guards should no longer fail to track you quite so easily. It's possible they're actually a little too 'Terminator' in this patch - feedback wanted!
[*]Added animations for collecting items and dropping off. This means you can't sprint past dangerous items and ignore the guards anymore - timing your collection becomes more important now.
[*]You can no longer interact with anything whilst rolling (this including picking stuff up)
[*]Improved Guard's ability to pivot and aim whilst not moving.
[*]Fire audio is no longer a point source
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.0006
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added Stamina. Rolling and Sprinting uses Stamina. Stamina recovers over time, and recovers twice as fast if Crouching.
[/list]

It's now literally too hot to stay in my house, so I'm going somewhere air-conditioned, and will continue work after the sun's gone down. 

Feedback always gratefully received.

notes.title: Patch 0.0005
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Using a Medkit at full health will now empty your hand.
[*]Added Crouch on Left Control. This makes you harder to detect, and you're safe behind 1 metre tall obstacles.
[*]Added Sprint on Left Shift (animation is placeholder). This makes you move faster, but drains your stamina bar.
[*]Reworked the entrance to the Base to improve occlusion and performance.
[*]Fixed an issue where people with low-end PCs optimistically chose a high detail and the LOD system would panic.
[/list]

Remember - I don't know what you think needs to be fixed unless you tell me!

notes.title: Patch 0.0004
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added further event triggers - the friendlies can now disable the streetlights and masts by turning off the generators.
[*]Fixed Bus Smoke
[*]Fire is no longer silent
[*]Added audio to Smoke Grenades
[*]Fixed dozens of small geometry errors
[*]Keemstar's hat is no longer made of shiny
[*]Added 3 difficulties - EzMode, Regular and GitGud. This will also halve or double your score.
[*]Fixed some LOD popping issues. You don't need to run on 'Potato' unless you've got a really crap PC...
[*]Added some auto-balancing FPS code, so the game should be always playable on low-spec rigs and also the detail will turn up automatically if your PC is capable.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.0003
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Scaled Ambient Occlusion by detail setting, increasing performance
[*]Set up Q/LMB for Primary Use and E/RMB for Secondary Use, rebindable in the Launcher
[*]Removed SlowmoTime from (T)
[*]Removed Death key (oops)
[*]Added Smoke Grenades - Guards are unable to target through them, tho they can blind fire into them. Lasts 30 seconds and follows camera forwards, not character forward.
[video]https://i.gyazo.com/177e9b9740ba74866ed3a5456779338e.mp4[/video]
[*]Large boost to loading times!
[*]More Gear added outside the base, allowing you to gear up before entering the fight.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.0002
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Added usable items - Q or LMB for left hand use and E or RMB for right hand use.
[*]Fixed issues where Gnomes weren't always collectable
[*]Fixed issue where player didn't always heal after dropping an Alien off
[*]Fixed issue where guards couldn't shoot the player when standing on sloped ground.
[*]Added instant-use FieldKits that give 50 HP when touched
[*]Added delay-use MedKits that give 25 HP when used. They take up a hand to carry.
[*]Added Cloak. You cannot be targetted by guards when active, and any current guards will immediately drop you as a target. Uses up a hand to carry.

[video]https://i.gyazo.com/14fadf95c0a07523c18b05134cfcbab7.mp4[/video]

[*]Added Body armour. This effectively gives 100 extra health, and allows you to break the 100% health barrier. Your health bar will be green when the armour is active.
[*]Fixed some 2d sound issues
[*]Added a random powerup system - MedKits, FieldKits and Body Armour will now spawn randomly. Prefer a fixed setup over randomness? Let me know!
[*]Added 20 random powerups throughout the level. Too easy now? 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.001 out now
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed score calculation and improved time readout
[*]Dying no longer completely covers the floor in 3,000 gallons of blood
[*]Player can no longer end up with a negative score
[*]Guards can no longer shoot eachother. Oops.
[video]https://i.gyazo.com/d0af7cc481fb762520367d975a3e6126.mp4[/video]
[*]Optimisation to navmesh generation to speed up pathfinding time
[*]Added Gnome Bonus! Find gnomes to boost your score. There's 20 in total, each worth 5,000 points.
[/list]
